subject: Request: trial credit rollover + short extension for integration blockers
messages:
From: Susan Green <susan.green@greenbyte.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, procurement@greenbyte.ai
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integration delays — request to roll unused trial balance and short extension

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our side: our engineering team ran into a blocker with the webhook authentication flow while trying to finish the Greenbyte -> Redwood pilot integration. We've attached the tracer output and a short log excerpt (integration-error.log). The issue is on our end but it will take us a bit to clear — estimated 10 business days.

Given that, could Redwood do two things so we can keep momentum?
- Roll the remainder of our trial balance (we've only used ~12% of the trial tokens) into a promotional credit we can consume once our integration is live.
- Provide a short trial window extension (10–14 days) so we don't lose evaluation time while we fix the webhook/auth issue.

We're close to completing an internal security review and procurement step; Ethan (cc'd) is coordinating procurement. Appreciate any flexibility here — we really like Redwood's performance profile so far.

Best,
Susan Green
Head of Integrations, Greenbyte Analytics

Attachment: integration-error.log
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Susan Green <susan.green@greenbyte.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration delays — request to roll unused trial balance and short extension

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up and for the log. Sorry to hear you're blocked. We can absolutely help so you don't lose evaluation time.

Proposed next steps from our side: 
1) I'll request a temporary rollover of the unused trial balance into a promo credit tied to your account (RDW-8672).
2) We can also extend your trial window by 14 days to cover the integration work.
3) Procurement note: if you need a short addendum to the SOW or a billing confirmation to finish procurement, I can loop in our contracts team.

I'm cc'ing Marissa and Monica for a quick internal approval on the credit amount and extension duration. Will confirm once we sign off.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — North America
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-29T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Greenbyte — trial rollover & short extension (approval request)

Marissa / Monica,

Forwarding Greenbyte's ask. Summary: customer is blocked on webhook auth; they've used ~12% of trial tokens. They want the unused balance rolled into a promo credit and a 10–14 day extension. Procurement is pending, but this is a high-prop pilot with clear intent to purchase if integration completes.

Suggested approval (low risk):
- Promo credit: convert unused trial balance to a $2,500 credit (est. ~60k tokens at current rates) — non-refundable, single-use against hosted API.
- Trial extension: +14 days from the current trial expiry date.
- Require a follow-up email from customer acknowledging the credit & extension terms (I can send a confirmation).

Why approve: keeps momentum, preserves a likely mid-market deal, minimal revenue impact and helps procurement unblock.

Can you confirm? If you want a smaller credit we can scale down.

— Jonas

On May 28 11:05, jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up ...
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Susan Green <susan.green@greenbyte.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration delays — request to roll unused trial balance and short extension

Hi Susan and team,

Thanks for the note and the log. We reviewed the request internally and are happy to help keep your evaluation on track. Here is what we're approving: 

1) Trial credit rollover: we've converted the unused portion of your trial into a $2,500 promotional credit (single-use) that will be applied to your Greenbyte Analytics account (deal RDW-8672). Please see attached confirmation (trial-rollover-confirmation.pdf).
2) Trial extension: an additional 14 days from your current trial expiry.

A few operational details:
- The promo credit is limited to hosted API usage and cannot be redeemed for invoice refunds.
- We'll auto-apply the credit when your team resumes requests from the account we have on file — if you prefer the credit to be applied only after procurement completes, let us know and we'll hold off.
- Attached is a short SOW addendum (SOW-draft.pdf) in case procurement needs a line-item to close the purchase.

If you could reply to confirm acceptance of the terms, we'll finalize the credit application and extension today. Happy to jump on a quick call if your engineers want to walk through the webhook troubleshooting with our integration team.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: trial-rollover-confirmation.pdf, SOW-draft.pdf
